# Pagination props

## Pagination.Root Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `labels` | `Partial<PaginationLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_PAGINATION_LABELS`. `aria-label` on Root and `children` on Previous and Next take precedence. |

## Pagination.Link Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks this link as the current page, setting `aria-current="page"`. |
| `render` | `RenderElement` | — | Custom React element to render instead of the default `<a>` tag. |

## Pagination.Previous / Pagination.Next Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `render` | `RenderElement` | — | Custom React element to render instead of the default `<a>` tag. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `root` | `string` | `"Pagination"` | Name of the `Pagination.Root` navigation landmark. |
| `previous` | `string` | `"Previous"` | Text of `Pagination.Previous` when it has no children. |
| `next` | `string` | `"Next"` | Text of `Pagination.Next` when it has no children. |
| `ellipsis` | `string` | `"More pages"` | Screen-reader text of `Pagination.Ellipsis`. |
